stages.name: Opening
stages.purpose: Confirm you have reached the intended person and introduce yourself and your company clearly.
they_may_say: From where? Can you say it again?
tap_options: Asked who is calling or from where

stages.name: Purpose
stages.purpose: Explain why you are calling, why the conversation is relevant to the prospect's company, and what you would like to discuss.
they_may_say: No, no. Regarding what is it, madam?
So what is that regarding? What do I need to help you with in this?

stages.name: Permission
stages.purpose: Check whether the prospect can speak now. If they are busy, agree on a suitable callback time rather than continuing without permission.
they_may_say: I am just getting into a school event. Can we speak at 1:30, Rohit?

stages.name: Their Business
stages.purpose: Understand what the prospect's company does, how it operates, which customers it serves, and how its business model works.
they_may_say: We are only manufacturing. We do only manufacturing.
I'm currently dealing in India only, and the clients I work with are very old relations.
Our company majorly works on a job work basis. We are into chemical manufacturing, and we majorly work on job work.

stages.name: Their Need
stages.purpose: Understand the prospect's goals, business challenges, and priorities. Capture the need in the prospect's own words without assuming what the problem is.
they_may_say: The biggest challenge is manpower requirement. Skilled manpower.
Probably I'm looking for people who can help me with some new products. Not discovering, but getting into new products, with our facility.
Nowadays my customers are more and more into sustainability. So what best can we offer them in terms of a sustainable solution?

stages.name: Objection
stages.purpose: Understand the prospect's concern, acknowledge it, and respond respectfully when appropriate. Do not pressure a prospect who declines or asks not to be contacted again.
they_may_say: Meri internal team hai, to hum log nahi karte abhi.
How is this different from the other companies who are doing and submitting reports? Is anything new going to come? Because we do have a lot of reports.
No, I don't have time for such work. You should call somebody else. Thank you.
tap_options: Already handled internally or by an existing provider
No time or no current need
Declined or requested no further contact
